description: Offer ONE price to move ONE condition of ONE place up ONE rung of the Vealth Standard (Unread, Read, Tended, Kept, Whole), over open packets at that place that serve that condition (find_work near the place; place_standing gives each condition's rung). Name every packet with its share of the price; the shares must add up exactly. Name how you expect to be paid: usdc (the board's USDC rail on Base), token (your group's ERC-20 on Base 8453 or Robinhood Chain 4663) or work_credit. FREE: a signed offer, no fee, no gas, NO money moves and none is held. The packets' creator decides; accepting holds the packets for you and each is then claimed at its share through the same admission every claim passes. A person accepts every proof; whether the rung was reached is read from the Standing, never from you. Every problem is named before you sign. Returns MESSAGE_TO_SIGN and BODY_JSON; sign with the bidder wallet's personal_sign, then call submit_outcome_bid within 5 minutes.

bidderWallet.description: The 0x address that will sign, hold the claims and be paid. Address only, never a key.

condition.description: The Standard's condition id, for example the_ground_is_alive (place_standing lists them).

crew.description: Optional: the people who will do the hours, as { ref, label? } (the managed account).

holdDays.description: Optional: how many days, 1 to 90, the packets stay held for you once accepted. Default 30.

packets.description: The open packets you will use, each with its share of the price. At most 25.

paymentTerms.description: How you expect to be paid. A declaration only: money moves on the existing rails, never through this bid.

token.description: The ERC-20 contract, for the token rail only.

place.description: The place: a placeId (plc_...), an address, or a venue|city reference.

priceUsd.description: Your one price in USD, in whole cents.

targetRung.description: The rung you will move the condition to: exactly one above where it reads now.

name: prepare_outcome_bid
title: Bid one price for one rung at one place (step 1 of 2)
